name: neuro-noise
summary: Full-bleed hero running Paper Shaders' neuro noise on WebGL2: fine branching filaments drifting through near-black, bright only where they fold over themselves. The quietest background in the set.

colorFront.description: The filament highlight, where the strands overlap. Omit to read --fx-c1 off the section, which is what keeps the shader and the CSS resting state on one palette. Upstream default preset.

colorMid.description: The body of the filaments. Omit to read --fx-c2 off the section.

colorBack.description: The field behind them. Omit to read --fx-c3 off the section.

speed.description: Rate the filaments travel. 0 renders a single static frame. Forced to 0 under prefers-reduced-motion.

brightness.description: Floor the whole field is lifted to, so it never reads as dead black.

contrast.description: How hard the filaments separate from the field. Higher is a starker, wirier picture.
